description:
A developer at AcmeCorp has deployed a document management application on the 'acmecorp.test' domain. Users are reporting failures when uploading files larger than 2MB, and batch import jobs are timing out. You need to modify the PHP configuration for the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server.

Using the Virtualmin web interface (https://localhost:10000), navigate to the PHP configuration settings for the 'acmecorp.test' domain and set the following four PHP directives:

- upload_max_filesize = 64M
- post_max_size = 128M
- memory_limit = 256M
- max_execution_time = 300

Ensure you save the changes so they take effect.
